summary: Created `opsadmin` on node1 with an active on-node-generated credential, private `/home/opsadmin`, and full administrative privileges. Verified persistence after reboot.
actions_performed: Created the local account with `/bin/bash` and `/home/opsadmin`.
Set home ownership to `opsadmin:opsadmin` and permissions to 0700.
Added `opsadmin` to `wheel`; authenticated sudo execution returned UID 0.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed a changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Local administrator account with full privileges
evidence.summary: Shows successful account creation, authenticated administrative execution as UID 0, local passwd entry, active password state, wheel membership, and `(ALL) ALL` sudo authorization before and after reboot.
Shows `/home/opsadmin` owned by `opsadmin:opsadmin` with exact mode 0700 and owner read/write/execute access, including after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID `45c22b1f-31bf-419b-a1a4-331c4aa1a40a`; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned with changed boot ID `a350530f-1582-439c-b0a7-34d8eda5c075`; system state was running with zero failed units and all account, home, and sudo state recovered.
